# Loop reversal with no dependence: for i := len(s) - 1; i >= 0; i-- is
# accepted, because the body only touches each slice at index i, so
# direction cannot change the result. The rewritten loop always runs
# forward.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func FillFromReverse(a, b []float32) {
	for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i] = b[i] + 1
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func FillFromReverse(a, b []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	if _loopvecOverlap(a, b) {
		for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			a[i] = b[i] + 1
		}
	} else {
		if len(a) > 0 {
			_ = b[len(a)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(b[_i:])
				_v1.Add(_vcFloat32s0).StorePart(a[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T) bool {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	aStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	aEnd := aStart + uintptr(len(a))*unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	bStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	bEnd := bStart + uintptr(len(b))*unsafe.Sizeof(b[0])
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	a := make([]float32, 5)
	b := []float32{1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5}
	test.FillFromReverse(a, b)
	fmt.Println(a)
}
-- testmain/output --
[2.5 3.5 4.5 5.5 6.5]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func FillFromReverse(a, b []float32) {
	for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i] = b[i] + 1
	}
}
